design_timing: Written before executing this follow-up renderer on the already inspected cache; not a preregistration or a new experiment.
missing_reading_policy: Fail closed; require all three nonempty cached readings at every locus.
tokenization: Whitespace-delimited complete cached wholes only; retain original source strings alongside token displays.
conservation: One output item per source token, in unchanged order, retaining repeats; source locus order and all three reader variants retained.
prohibited: reader variants treated as independent witnesses
validation_scope: Lexical substitution reproducibility and conservation only; no meanings validated.
